description: This file defines an interface `EntitlementConsumptionStrategy` within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for the leave entitlement module. It declares methods for handling leave creation, cancellation, status changes, leave period adjustments, and related calculations related to leave entitlements and periods.

classes.name: EntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: An interface that defines strategies for consuming leave entitlements, including handling leave creation, cancellation, status changes, period changes, and entitlement calculations.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Handles the logic when a leave is created for an employee, potentially returning current and changeable entitlements.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the logic when an existing leave is canceled.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the entitlement status, details unspecified in interface.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles updates when the leave period for an employee changes, adjusting related entitlement data.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Returns date limits for considering leave without entitlements in the leave balance calculation.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period for a specific date, employee, and leave type.
